annotations.title: Seal my roster for a tournament

description: Seals one of the signed-in player's saved rosters for a tournament or hidden-list game, or replaces the list sealed before, with the site's checks: battle size, points, the event's house rules, a Warlord, and the roster deadline. Sealing stores a copy; later edits to the saved roster don't change it. Before the reveal only you and an assigned ally can read it. Check the roster with get_my_roster first, and seal only after the player confirms. Requires mcp:write.

eventToken.description: eventToken from list_my_events; only an old link needs it.

token.description: The tournament or hidden-list game token, from list_my_events or its invite link.
